records.content: Primitive types have specific byte sizes and ranges: byte uses 1 byte and stores values from -128 to 127; short uses 2 bytes and stores values up to about 32,000; int uses 4 bytes and stores values up to roughly 2 billion; long uses 8 bytes and stores even larger numbers.

 and with this we can store values up to 32,000.

Next we have
 integer, which we have seen before, integers take 4 bytes of memory and
 allow us to store values up to 2 billion.
